Question pool: review sheet

Pool for the continuous text block (genes t, u). Distance d = 1 - cos(all-MiniLM-L6-v2) to the original question. d_max = 0.2783 (95% quantile of all pool distances), 20 bands of width 0.0139. Generated by scripts/build_question_pool.py; full data in configs/text/question_pool.json.

Rules

Already approved (T-B review and the validity filters):

  • ends with '?'
  • every protected word kept
  • dictionary words only
  • a/an agreement
  • no presupposed object ('the/this <object>')
  • no category or identity question about the object
  • no whole-image reading ('image of a ...')
  • no second medium word (picture, photo, ...)
  • NLI mutual entailment >= 0.8 (both directions)
  • CoLA >= max(min(0.5, a0), 0.9 a0)

Extra meaning rules, proposed by C1, for approval (each rejects candidates that passed NLI but change what is asked):

  1. whole-image reading (the image IS / represents the object)
  2. changes the referent ('an image' instead of the given image)
  3. odd preposition before 'image'
  4. odd reference to the image ('above image', 'pictured image')
  5. 'another' presupposes a first object
  6. changes who is asked (they / me / I)
  7. adverb that changes the question
  8. odd preposition before 'image'
  9. changes what 'subject' asks for
  10. changes the question (realness, permission, probability, 'reflect')
  11. changes who is asked (it / one / someone)
  12. odd question form ('can you know', 'expect', 'is it the case if')
  13. asks about putting the object into the image
  14. the asker (not the image) contains the object ('do you include a dog')
  15. a request or task instead of the question
  16. hedged / opinion question
  17. quantity or kind of the object
  18. the image as the subject of a copula / modal (whole-image reading)
  19. adds a role for the object
  20. asks about use / interpretation, not presence
  21. repeated word
  22. resemblance / whole-image reading
  23. identity question (is the object a ...)
  24. a request to describe (not the question)
  25. existential reading (does X exist)
  26. parenthetical (odd reading)
  27. indefinite or demonstrative 'subject' (a subject, not THE main subject)
  28. distal demonstrative 'that image'
  29. adds a use, property or second question
  30. 'image VERB <object>' with VERB outside capture/contain/depict/display/exhibit/feature/has/have/illustrate/include/portray/present/reveal/show/showcase
  31. 'can you VERB <object>' with VERB outside confirm/detect/determine/find/identify/locate/notice/observe/see/spot/tell/verify
  32. object word repeated (self-definition)
  33. adds content about the object (hyphen compound: 'broccoli-like', 'remote-controlled')
  34. modifier before the object ('lone dog', 'actual person')
  35. adds content about the object (possessive, compound noun or relative clause after it)
  36. growth only: a grown entry (word substitutions on a paraphrase, extra T5 samples) may use only words that occur in an original question or in an accepted first-pass entry of any question
